title: Straight Torque Adapter
introduction:
Torque depends on both the force you apply and the distance from that force to the fastener. This adapter arrangement changes that effective distance, so the number you set on the wrench may differ from the fastener specification.

Match your setup to the original drawing, take the indicated center-to-center measurements, and enter the specified fastener torque. The calculator then gives the corresponding wrench setting in each supported unit.

checks.notes: Calculator UI preserves and verifies original mathematical behavior; all source illustrations retained.
